name: Party Registration And Guarantee Notification V 01
definition: The PartyRegistrationAndGuaranteeNotification message is sent by a factoring client or a financial service to a trade partner and, optionally, to an interested party in order to notify the status of a requested financial service agreement. The trade partner is given information to explain the consequences of a financial service agreement, for instance, the trade partner must pay the financial institution and must use the electronic address to inform it and pay it using the bank account given.|The message may reference related messages and may include referenced data.|The message can carry digital signatures if required by context.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Set of characteristics that unambiguously identify the notification, common parameters, documents and identifications.

NotificationCount.name: Notification Count
NotificationCount.definition: Number of notification lists as control value.

ItemCount.name: Item Count
ItemCount.definition: Total number of individual items in all lists.

ControlSum.name: Control Sum
ControlSum.definition: Total of all individual amounts included in all lists, irrespective of currencies or direction.
